FX-SGLOW-001.says: Radius 12, everything else at the effect's defaults (threshold 0, so everything glows; Screen; exposure 1): a soft glow with a bright core and a long tail spreads round every patch into the empty space.

FX-SGLOW-002.says: The effect's own defaults, radius 500: the glow is spread so wide that on a drawing this small it is a faint wash; the drawing shows through brighter where it doubles on itself.

FX-SGLOW-003.says: Radius 0: nothing spreads; the light is laid on itself, so each pixel is doubled and held at white.

FX-SGLOW-004.says: Radius 1.5: the first level is too small to count yet, so this is still FX-SGLOW-003.

FX-SGLOW-005.says: Radius 2.25: the first level is half in, so the glow is half spread and half laid on itself.

FX-SGLOW-006.says: Radius 100: seven levels, the larger three worked on cells of 8, 4 and 2 pixels.

FX-SGLOW-007.says: Threshold 30, Chroma: each channel tested on its own: the yellow's red and green glow and its blue does not, the brown's red glows, the purple does not glow.

FX-SGLOW-008.says: Threshold 30, Luminance: one brightness per pixel: only the yellow glows, all three of its channels.

FX-SGLOW-009.says: Threshold 30, Smooth 50: a channel between 15 % and 30 % glows in proportion: the yellow's blue, at 19 %, glows at a quarter.

FX-SGLOW-010.says: Saturation Bias 100, threshold 50, the grey drawing: the test is on saturation alone: the yellow and the purple glow, the grey does not.

FX-SGLOW-011.says: Saturation Bias -100, threshold 50: the other way round: only the grey glows.

FX-SGLOW-012.says: Saturation Bias 50, threshold 40: halfway: the colourful patches glow in every channel, the grey, bright as it is, does not.

FX-SGLOW-013.says: Aspect Ratio 1.6: the glow is stretched sideways and squeezed top to bottom.

FX-SGLOW-015.says: Aspect Ratio 1.5 at Angle 30: the oval leans, its long side 30 degrees below the horizontal, going right.

FX-SGLOW-016.says: Aspect Ratio 1.5 at Angle 60: steeper, worked the other way round (slanted line along x).

FX-SGLOW-017.says: Aspect Ratio 2: a flat streak, no spread top to bottom except the softening that working on cells gives.

FX-SGLOW-018.says: Blend Mode Add, exposure 3: the light adds up and is not cut off at white.

FX-SGLOW-019.says: Blend Mode Screen, exposure 3: the same, held at white.

FX-SGLOW-020.says: Source Opacity 0: the glow alone, the drawing not laid back.

FX-SGLOW-021.says: Source Opacity 50: the drawing laid back at half strength.

FX-SGLOW-022.says: Unmult off: the glow sits on solid black, every pixel fully covering.

FX-SGLOW-023.says: Unmult off, Source Opacity 0: the glow alone on black.

FX-SGLOW-024.says: The patches half covering, threshold 50: the colour is multiplied by its covering first, so the yellow counts at half and nothing glows: the drawing, untouched.

FX-SGLOW-025.says: The patches half covering, threshold 0: they glow at half the strength of FX-SGLOW-001.

FX-SGLOW-026.says: FX-SGLOW-001 moved three pixels right: the glow that spread past the drawing's left edge shows in columns 0 to 2; the layer grew to hold it.

FX-SGLOW-027.says: FX-SGLOW-001 moved six pixels left: the yellow patch is off the composition, and its glow still lights the frame's left side.

FX-SGLOW-028.says: Radius keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-SGLOW-003, frame 4 is FX-SGLOW-006.

FX-SGLOW-029.says: Exposure keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 2 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is FX-SGLOW-001.

FX-SGLOW-030.says: Threshold 100: nothing in the drawing is that bright: the drawing, untouched.

FX-SGLOW-031.says: Radius 2,000, the largest: eleven levels; on a drawing this small the glow is a very faint wash.

FX-SGLOW-032.says: Threshold 30, Smooth 50, Saturation Bias 50, Luminance, Add, exposure 1.5, Aspect Ratio 0.7 at Angle -20, Source Opacity 80, radius 30: everything at once.

FX-SGLOW-033.says: Falloff "gaussian", which is not classic or physical. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SGLOW-034.says: Radius 2001, above 2000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SGLOW-035.says: Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SGLOW-036.says: Radius keyed to 2500 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SGLOW-037.says: Saturation Bias 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SGLOW-038.says: Threshold Smooth 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SGLOW-039.says: Threshold -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SGLOW-040.says: Aspect Ratio 2.1, above 2. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SGLOW-041.says: Exposure -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SGLOW-042.says: Source Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
